tools.title: 查看智能消息状态
tools.description: Read the current App's intelligent-messaging service status and non-sensitive quota/history settings. Credentials are never returned to the model.

tools.title: 查看可用模型
tools.description: List chat and embedding models available to the current App. Use before changing an Agent model; never invent a vendor or model ID.

tools.title: 查看 Agent 列表
tools.description: List Agents in the current App so a real chatbot_id can be selected before reading or changing configuration.

tools.title: 创建 Agent
tools.description: Create an Agent. name is the display name and desc is its optional description; creation does not bind plugins or knowledge bases.

desc.description: Optional Agent description; an empty string clears it.

tools.title: 修改 Agent 配置
tools.description: Partially update an Agent. Send chatbot_id plus only requested fields; omitted fields remain unchanged and plugin_ids=[] explicitly unbinds all plugins.

system_prompt.description: System prompt, maximum 20000 characters; empty string clears it.

vendor.description: Model vendor ID returned by seenical.model.list.

plugin_ids.description: Complete plugin binding list; [] unbinds all plugins.

tools.title: 查看 Agent 插件绑定
tools.description: Read the current Agent-to-plugin binding relations before changing them.

tools.title: 修改 Agent 插件绑定
tools.description: Replace one Agent or plugin binding list. Read current relations first; list=[] explicitly removes the selected relation.

type.description: plugin_list binds plugins to an Agent name; preset_name_list binds one plugin to Agent names.

name.description: Agent preset name for plugin_list, or plugin ID for preset_name_list.

list.description: Complete target ID/name list; [] clears the binding.
